title: Arivina Angala, Science Fest for regional-language Students
teaser: A science fest for regional-language students, jointly organised with Banavasi Balaga and ScienceUtsav, featuring hands-on experiments, a Raman museum visit, and a quiz contest.
homepageMatter: Arivina Angala (ಅರಿವಿನ ಅಂಗಳ) was a full-day science fest for regional-language students from 7 schools in and around Bengaluru, jointly organised with Banavasi Balaga and ScienceUtsav at the Indian Academy of Sciences campus.
